task_completion.description: Add at least 3 partition walls and define at least 4 named rooms (e.g., Nap Room, Play Area, Kitchen, Staff Office).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for new wall segments in the 2D plan and room labels/tags appearing in the 2D floor plan view or the furniture list.

task_completion.description: Place at least 14 chairs and 6 tables in activity areas.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count chairs and tables in the 2D plan or 3D view; verify the furniture list shows at least 14 chair-type items and 6 table-type items.

task_completion.description: Place at least 6 beds in the designated nap room.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify a room labeled for napping and count at least 6 bed/cot models within that space.

task_completion.description: Place 3 kitchen appliances, 3 toilets, 2 sinks, and a staff desk with seating.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check the kitchen and restroom areas for specific models (fridge/stove, toilets, sinks) and the office for a desk and chair.

task_completion.description: Ensure the completed plan contains at least 40 total furniture items.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check the furniture list panel (usually on the left or bottom left) to see if the total count of rows/items reaches 40.

task_completion.description: Draw at least 2 evacuation route polylines from interior zones to exits.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for polyline/line markings (often colored or dashed) on the 2D floor plan leading from rooms to exterior doors.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place items and draw walls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the catalog, 2D plan, and menu bars, rather than just terminal output.

integrity.description: The agent opened and saved the specific file 'daycare_center_starter.sh3d'.
integrity.visual_evidence: The window title bar or the 'Open' dialog should show the correct file name.

integrity.description: The design shows incremental progress rather than an instant appearance of a finished state.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires converting 'daycare_center_starter.sh3d' into a daycare. Key requirements: 3+ walls, 4+ named rooms, 14+ chairs, 6+ tables, 6+ beds, 3 kitchen appliances, 3 toilets, 2 sinks, 1 staff desk/chair, 40+ total furniture items, and 2+ evacuation polylines.
